name: Necromancer: casting Graveyard keeps the server up and raises its Tombstones (#322)
contract: Graveyard 805197 (Spell.dbc; the Necromancer's level-60 ability, SkillLineAbility 23498, AscensionCustomClassData {23, 60, 805197}) is cast at a ground location (Targets 64, range index 4 = 30 yd). Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL 899900 (Tombstone Layout A: two Tombstone 542064 summons plus trigger 899901 with three more, all routed through spell_ascension_necromancer_summon). Effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_PERSISTENT_AREA_AURA (27) carrying SPELL_AURA_MOD_DECREASE_SPEED (33), BasePoints -41 (-40%), TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY, radius index 13 (10 yd), duration index 18 (20 s): the tooltip's 'slowing the movement speed of enemies inside by 40% ... Lasts 20 sec'. Each Tombstone's AI (npc_ascension_necromancer event 4, every 3 s from 2 s) makes its owner cast Graveyard 500365, the 'raising the Undead from the ground' step. The report came from a level-1 Necromancer on core revision a8b28faac: creating the persistent aura's DynObjAura runs Aura::CalcMaxDuration -> AllSpellScript::OnCalcMaxDuration, where necromancer_casts then called Aura::GetUnitOwner(), which ASSERTs GetType() == UNIT_AURA_TYPE, so every Graveyard cast aborted the worldserver. 38ba75a04 (#3083) checks the aura type first. Both the reported level 1 and the acquisition level 60 cast it at a Harvest Golem 20 yd away. 500365 resolves its destination from its caster (effect 0 TARGET_DEST_CASTER with an 8 yd TARGET_DEST_DEST_RANDOM offset) and deals its damage within 6 yd of that point, so it cannot reach the golem and the golem stays out of combat. The case requires each ground effect, its slow on the golem, the Tombstones and their raise casts, each ground effect's expiry after 20 s and both casters alive afterwards.
